scripts.contracts:generate: turbo run build --filter=@ledgerline/api... && tsx apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.yaml -o packages/contracts/src/client/schema.gen.ts && prettier --write packages/contracts/src/client/schema.gen.ts >/dev/null
scripts.contracts:check: turbo run build --filter=@ledgerline/api... && tsx apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts --check && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.yaml -o /tmp/ledgerline-schema.gen.ts && prettier --stdin-filepath x.ts < /tmp/ledgerline-schema.gen.ts | diff -q - packages/contracts/src/client/schema.gen.ts && redocly lint packages/contracts/openapi.yaml
